name: Henle Second Year Latin
_note: The lessons are the 32 of Part IV, 'Exercises Based on Caesar' (pp. 305-520), which review the forms of First Year and add the rest. grammar: the lesson in which each form is taken up, from the lesson titles in the table of contents and the forms the lesson's own text and exercises give. The declensions are taken as known from First Year (Lesson 1 reviews the third). The typed games open a row or column once the lesson filter reaches that number. null means the form is not taught in this book. Compounds follow their base verb (dēsum like sum, trānseō like eō, cōnferō like ferō). The words: the Classified Word List (pp. 551-584). A word the list marks with an asterisk is a second-year word and belongs to the first lesson whose VOCABULARY has it; the others are the required words of First Year, entered at Lesson 1 with "review": true.

_source.L2: review of adjectives: first and second declensions (with miser and integer) and the third (gravis)
_source.L3: indicative active of the four conjugations and of -iō verbs; quis, quid
_source.L4: present subjunctive active of the four conjugations, -iō verbs and sum
_source.L5: the subjunctive active, all four tenses, and of sum
_source.L7: indicative passive of the four conjugations and of -iō verbs
_source.L9: subjunctive passive of the four conjugations and of -iō verbs
_source.L10: other adjectives of the third declension: ācer, celer, audāx, dīligēns
_source.L11: indicative and subjunctive of deponent verbs (no infinitives or participles yet)
_source.L15: eō and its compounds, indicative and subjunctive
_source.L17: adjectives with the genitive in -īus (ūnus, alius, tōtus…); numerals
_source.L18: ferō, active and perfect system passive; ipse; the perfect participle passive (pp. 407-411; of deponents p. 414)
_source.L19: possum; the present infinitive, active and passive (p. 421)
_source.L20: accusative with the infinitive: perfect infinitive active and passive (p. 435), future participle and future infinitive active (p. 437). The future infinitive passive is not given
_source.L22: present participle active (pp. 454-457), with ferēns and iēns
_source.L23: volō (nōlō and mālō are not taught)
_source.L26-28: the gerund and gerundive (not in the games)
_source.L29: the vocative; the imperative, present active and passive, with ī, fer, nōlī and the deponents (p. 507). No imperative of sum, possum, volō or fīō in the lesson
